concept.title: The Lid Comes Off
concept.hook: First second: a hand unbuttons a crisp collared shirt cuff by the entryway as a tote bag thuds onto a bench. Overlay: The workday ends when this lid comes off.
concept.surpriseBeat: The room visibly shifts: as the flame settles, the lamps dim by themselves in a soft fade and the cool dusk light warms to amber, so the candle seems to switch the whole evening over.

locations.description: Narrow entryway with coat hooks and a wooden bench where a tote bag is dropped
locations.lighting: Cool blue window light fading, a single dim lamp

locations.description: Lived-in apartment living room with a linen sofa, throw blanket and a small side table
locations.lighting: Candlelight as key, dim lamp as fill, warm amber grade

scenes.action: A tired adult in their early 30s drops a tote bag on the entryway bench and unbuttons a crisp collared shirt cuff.
scenes.framing: Medium close on torso and hands, shallow depth of field
scenes.lighting: Cool dusk window light with a dim lamp
scenes.overlayText: The workday ends when this lid comes off.
scenes.sound: Tote thud on wood, soft exhale, faint room tone

scenes.action: Now in an oatmeal knit cardigan and lounge pants, the adult lifts the charcoal lid off the candle jar and sets the lid down beside it on the side table.
scenes.framing: Close on the jar on the side table, leaf label facing camera, hands entering late and staying at the sides of the jar
scenes.motion: Lid lifted straight up and set aside, one simple move
scenes.lighting: Dim lamp fill, warm amber grade
scenes.sound: Soft ceramic and glass clink of the lid, fingerpicked guitar begins

scenes.action: The adult lights the single cotton wick and sits back on the linen sofa, pulling the throw blanket over bare feet.
scenes.framing: Medium close, face half lit by the new flame
scenes.motion: Small settling movements, a long slow breath
scenes.dialogue: This is the moment the evening shifts.
scenes.sound: Soft match strike, brushed percussion enters

scenes.action: Macro on the flame and creamy wax pool glowing amber. The camera pulls back as the lamps fade softly down and the room turns to amber glow with shoulders visibly dropping.
scenes.framing: Starts macro on flame and wax, ends wide on the glowing living room
scenes.motion: Flame steadies, the adult's shoulders drop
scenes.lighting: Candlelight takes over as key as the lamp dims
scenes.sound: Warm piano pad swells, faint breathy hum

scenes.action: The candle sits centered on the side table, leaf label facing camera, flame lit. The adult's hand passes in with a charcoal lid only at the very end to rest it nearby, while a second adult's hand passes a mug in the background.
scenes.framing: Held centered product shot, label facing camera

rubric.reason: Follows the brief's ritual closely with a clear single emotion and a well staged product. The lamps dimming on their own is a gentle surprise, not a bold one.

concept.title: Shirt Off, Flame On
concept.hook: First second: a crash zoom onto a collared shirt being unbuttoned in the entryway, then a hard cut to a lit flame. Overlay: Your evening starts with one small flame.
concept.surpriseBeat: A quick cut-back shows the same jar unlit on the table, then the lit flame arrives in a match cut, revealing the whole ritual took only a few seconds and the room changes completely.

locations.description: Apartment living room at dusk with a linen sofa, throw blanket and small side table

scenes.action: A tired adult unbuttons a crisp collared shirt, a tote bag already dropped on a bench behind them.
scenes.framing: Tight on chest and hands, shallow depth of field
scenes.motion: Quick tired fingers, then a pause
scenes.overlayText: Your evening starts with one small flame.

scenes.action: The unlit candle sits on the side table with its charcoal lid on. The adult's hand lifts the lid straight up and away.
scenes.framing: Medium close on the jar, leaf label facing camera
scenes.sound: Fingerpicked guitar begins, soft glass clink

scenes.action: The adult, now in an oatmeal knit cardigan and wool socks, lights the wick and sinks into the linen sofa.
scenes.framing: Medium close, flame glow on face

scenes.action: Macro of the flame settling over the amber wax pool, then a slow pull back to the adult's shoulders dropping as the lamp dims.
scenes.framing: Macro on flame and wax pool
scenes.motion: Flame steadies and the wax glows
scenes.dialogue: Cedar, fig, black tea. Home, finally.

scenes.action: The candle held centered, leaf label to camera. The lid is set back on to close the evening as the flame goes out beneath it.
scenes.motion: Lid placed gently on the jar
scenes.sound: Soft lid clink, guitar fades out

rubric.reason: The crash zoom gives a strong first second and the lid closing covers the brief's ending. The surprise is mild and the single location is less varied.

concept.title: One Mug, One Flame
concept.hook: First second: a bare foot steps over a dropped tote bag, a collared shirt half unbuttoned, the room still cold and blue. Overlay: Cedar, fig, black tea. Home, finally.
concept.surpriseBeat: A second adult's hand slips a steaming mug into frame at the moment the flame settles, showing the evening was being held open for the person coming home.

scenes.action: A tired adult steps in, lets a tote bag drop onto the bench by the coat hooks and unbuttons a crisp collared shirt.
scenes.framing: Close on the adult, entryway sliding behind them
scenes.motion: Slow tired walk, a long exhale
scenes.overlayText: Cedar, fig, black tea. Home, finally.
scenes.sound: Door click, tote thud, quiet room tone

scenes.action: In an oatmeal cardigan and wool socks, the adult lifts the charcoal lid off the candle on the side table and sets it aside.
scenes.framing: Close on the jar with the leaf label facing camera
scenes.sound: Fingerpicked guitar enters, soft glass clink

scenes.dialogue: The evening is shifting. Let it.

scenes.action: Macro of the flame and amber wax pool. A second adult's hand passes a mug in the background, softly out of focus.
scenes.framing: Macro on flame, mug hand blurred behind
scenes.motion: Flame steady, mug gliding into frame
scenes.lighting: Candlelight key with warm lamp fill
scenes.sound: Warm piano pad, faint breathy hum

scenes.action: The jar sits centered on the side table, label to camera, lid resting beside it, the room glowing amber behind.

rubric.reason: Very clear cozy emotion and a tender mug moment that fits the brief. The opening is quieter for a scroll and the mug beat is background, so its surprise is soft.
